Miedź Legnica SA | nickname = ''Miedzianka '' | founded = {{Start date and years ago|df=yes|1971|9|14}} | ground = [[White Eagle Municipal Stadium]] | capacity = 6,244 | chairman = Tomasz Brusiło | manager = [[Dawid Kroczek]] | league = [[I liga]] | season = [[2025–26 I liga|2025–26]] | position = I liga, 8th of 18 | current = | website = {{URL|https://miedzlegnica.eu}} | pattern_la1 = _rizespor2627a | pattern_b1 = _miedz2627h | pattern_ra1 = _rizespor2627a | pattern_sh1 = _miedz2627h | pattern_so1 = _color_3_stripes_white | leftarm1 = 0000FF | body1 = 0000FF | rightarm1 = 0000FF | shorts1 = 0000FF | socks1 = 0000FF | pattern_la2 = _adidasicon25r | pattern_b2 = _adidasicon25r | pattern_ra2 = _adidasicon25r | pattern_sh2 = _adidastirocm25pr | pattern_so2 = _color_3_stripes_white | leftarm2 = FF0000 | body2 = FF0000 | rightarm2 = FF0000 | shorts2 = FF0000 | socks2 = FF0000| }} [[File:Stadium legnica.JPG|thumb|260px|[[White Eagle Municipal Stadium]]]] '''Miedź Legnica''' ({{IPA|pl|ˈmjɛt͡ɕ lɛɡˈɲit͡sa}}) is a professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Legnica]], [[Poland]], that competes in the [[I liga]], following relegation in [[2022–23 Ekstraklasa|2023]]. '''Miedź''' was founded in 1971. In 2018, Miedź Legnica achieved promotion to the top flight for the first time in club's history.{{cite web |url=https://www.przegladsportowy.pl/pilka-nozna/lotto-ekstraklasa/miedz-legnica-awansowala-do-ekstraklasy/93576hg |title=Miedź zagra w ekstraklasie |website=przegladsportowy.pl |access-date=15 June 2018 |language=pl |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180615221443/https://www.przegladsportowy.pl/pilka-nozna/lotto-ekstraklasa/miedz-legnica-awansowala-do-ekstraklasy/93576hg |archive-date=15 June 2018 |url-status=dead }} After a three-year absence from the [[Ekstraklasa|top flight]], they were promoted again at the end of the [[2021–22 I liga|2021–22 season]] after winning the league.{{cite web |title=Przegląd prasy: Awans Miedzi! |url=https://miedzlegnica.eu/aktualnosci/przeglad-prasy-awans-miedzi-11546 |publisher=Miedź Legnica |access-date=7 May 2022 |language=pl |date=2 May 2022 |archive-date=5 May 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230505235837/https://miedzlegnica.eu/aktualnosci/przeglad-prasy-awans-miedzi-11546 |url-status=live }}"}}
